Public has five minutes per person to ask questions or comment on any agenda item. 
Mayor Williams opened the public hearing up at 6 pm. 
 
Nicholas Patrick, 2821 Grant Street, presented from a handout discussing his desire to rezone the current I-P parcels to 
R-1 to preserve the neighborhood feeling in the area.  
 
Geneva Golden, 3126 Gilbert Street, discussed the leaning trees near her house and other houses nearby. She stated

about overgrowth in easements and alleys.  
 
Sue DeRosa, 3216 Bannon Drive, stated the last tree inventory was done in 2012. She stated the Town needed to apply 
for a grant to get a new direct inventory done of the trees in Thunderbolt.
